name: flp_edit
title: FLP Edit
description: Apply a validated list of mutations to an offline FL Studio project, writing atomically to a new or existing file.

file.description: Path to the source FL Studio project file (.flp).

destination.description: Target destination path for the edited project. If omitted, requires in_place: true.

in_place.description: Allow in-place overwrite with automatic timestamped backup (default: false).

mutations.description: List of validated mutation operations (e.g. set_tempo, rename_channel, set_notes, add_marker).

force_unknown_version.description: Bypass version protection for unknown or future FL Studio versions.
